g.title: scaler_polyphase
g.text: separable polyphase FIR, TAPS = 2..16 (even), programmable coefficient tables - engine of scaler_bicubic and scaler_lanczos
1 output pixel per clock - pipeline: 6 + 2*LV stages + output register (LV = ceil(log2 TAPS))
pixel = CHANNELS x COMP_W bits (default 3 x 8), component 0 in the LSBs

g.title: regbus
g.text: AW and W in any order, OKAY responses

g.title: ctrl
g.text: capture FSM: SOF / EOL checks, writes the

g.title: dda
g.text: exact accumulation, SOF / EOL / EOF flags
stalls with the pipeline (adv), hold for LINE_BUF

g.title: fb
g.text: 8 x 8 RAM banks (B = 8): a 8x8 window every clock

g.title: tables
g.text: CH: horizontal, 2^PB phases x TAPS 0x1000 + 4*(16*phase + tap)
CV: vertical, 2^PB phases x TAPS 0x2000 + 4*(16*phase + tap)
reset value: bilinear weights; write while idle

g.title: dp
g.text: A B W M1 T1..TLV S1 M2 H1..HLV: 6 + 2*LV stages
adder tree, one level per stage
